items.title: Dave Williams Interview, 1961-07-02
items.q: I relate to my grandfather's side. Your grandfather? Yeah, so my grandfather and Lawrence's mother are sisters and brothers.

ctx.x: I wanted to ask you about your family some more. How you, I knew you were related to the Morello's.
Morello's, that's right. Morello's Morello, yeah. My old Uncle Lawrence.
How are you related? Which is your mother?
